title: It would take no time to add the ability…
body: …to contract and expand subtasks visually in the lists. It would make the world of difference to be able to hide subtasks for readability. The visual is already implemented when moving a task with subtasks up or down, as you grab it, it contracts. First request on Google support forums for this feature dates back years, and they keep saying they’ll forward it to the team.

body:
A good app but it’s confusing that a repetitive task is put under Finished tasks when selected. The task is finished for that date but since it is repetitive it has a new date and should be shown there.
Look at Apple’s Reminders how repetitive tasks are handled and copy that.

title: Lack of feature
body:
Hello. 

Love the idea of this app. The interface is nice and it’s easy to use but the main drawback is that I can set a recurring task on multiple days. 

Let’s say I wanna set up a task to remind me to go to the gym every Monday, Wednesday, Friday and weekend. That’s not possible. 

Until we have that feature I can’t use the app. And I’m sure many people feel the same.
